result.paraphrase: The SSD you can rely on: Samsung’s 860 EVO, the latest model in the world’s best-selling SATA SSD lineup. Built for mainstream PCs and laptops, it uses the newest V-NAND and a sturdy algorithm-based controller to deliver fast, dependable performance across a broad range of compatible form factors and capacities. Improved performance keeps speeds steady even under heavy workloads and multitasking, with sequential writes up to 520 MB/s using Intelligent TurboWrite technology and sequential reads up to 550 MB/s. The TurboWrite buffer has also been expanded from 12 GB to 78 GB for quicker file transfers. Enhanced endurance lets you safely store and work with large 4K video and 3D data used by current applications, offering up to 8x the TBW of the previous 850 EVO. With the latest V-NAND, it reaches up to 2,400 TBW, or is covered by a 5-year limited warranty. Smart compatibility helps your system communicate more smoothly and quickly: the refined ECC algorithm and new MJX controller improve speed, while upgraded queued trim boosts Linux compatibility. Available in multiple form factors, the 860 EVO comes in a 2.5-inch version for desktop PCs and laptops, plus SATA-based M.2 (2280) and mSATA options for ultra-slim devices.
